def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find paired color markers above/below frame; fill the inner rectangle in opposing quadrants.
    marks=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v not in (0,5): marks.append((r,c,v))
    # frame bounds color 5
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    inside_h=r1-r0-1; inside_w=c1-c0-1
    # Two marker colors correspond to left/right and top/bottom pattern; split interior halves.
    a=next(v for r,c,v in marks if c < (c0+c1)/2)
    b=next(v for r,c,v in marks if c > (c0+c1)/2)
    h=inside_h//2; w=inside_w//2
    for r in range(r0+1,r0+1+h):
        for c in range(c0+1,c0+1+w): out[r][c]=a
        for c in range(c0+1+w,c1): out[r][c]=b
    for r in range(r0+1+h,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c0+1+w): out[r][c]=b
        for c in range(c0+1+w,c1): out[r][c]=a
    return out
PY
